messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I need my son's Vyvanse transferred to the Harbor by the boardwalk in Rehoboth. We're on vacation and he runs out Sunday.
AGENT: I'd be happy to help with that transfer. To get started, I need to verify your son's identity. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Yeah, it's Eli Brooks, born February 11th, 2010. I'm his dad, Kevin.
AGENT (LATEST): Thanks, Kevin. Let me verify that information for you. Great, I've verified Eli's information. I can see he's currently set up at store H-501. Now let me find the Harbor location by the boardwalk in Rehoboth for you. Perfect, I found it—Harbor Pharmacy Rehoboth Ave at 200 Rehoboth Ave, right near the boardwalk. Now let me pull up Eli's prescriptions so we can transfer the Vyvanse. I see the Vyvanse is a C-II controlled medication that's already been filled with no refills remaining. Because it's a C-II, I can't transfer a filled prescription—we'd need to request a new prescription from Dr. Okafor instead. Before I do that, let me confirm with the Rehoboth store that they can fill it for you. I'll have our pharmacist reach out to them and then get back to you. Okay, I've flagged this for our pharmacist to call you back today. They'll confirm the Rehoboth store can fill the Vyvanse by Sunday and then request a new prescription from Dr. Okafor. What's the best number to reach you?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores, list_prescriptions, flag_pharmacist_callback]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent asks for the dose or strength
move_1: the agent first says the Vyvanse cannot be transferred
move_3: the agent mentions contacting the doctor
move_4: the agent asks which Rehoboth store he means or reads out the two Rehoboth stores
stop_0: Agent recaps the plan: store, new-Rx request to Dr. Okafor, after-hours line, pharmacist verification.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "No dose or strength question asked."}, "move_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent first states C-II can't be transferred."}, "move_3": {"met": true, "why": "Agent mentions requesting new prescription from Dr. Okafor."}, "move_4": {"met": false, "why": "Agent didn't clarify or list two Rehoboth stores."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No after-hours line mentioned in recap."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
